procedure: Press each emergency stop device during automatic motion at full programmed speed and record the drive status.
pass_criterion: Arm decelerates on its path, then torque is removed. Repeated for every device.

procedure: Press the emergency stop in automatic, manual and paused state.
pass_criterion: Stop occurs in every mode and no other command can override it.

procedure: Release the emergency stop device after a stop and wait 60 s without pressing start.
pass_criterion: No motion until a separate start command is given.

procedure: Record the emergency stop input and the STO status signal with an oscilloscope or drive trace at maximum speed and payload. Repeat 10 times.
pass_criterion: Longest time from input to STO is 500 ms or less.

procedure: Measure contact force with a calibrated force and pressure measuring device at the clamping points identified in H-02 and H-03. Repeat 10 times per point.
pass_criterion: Highest quasi-static force is 140 N or less at every point.

procedure: Block the arm with the measuring device during programmed motion.
pass_criterion: Robot performs a protective stop and reports a force limit violation.

procedure: After the stop in TC-06, push the arm away from the measuring device by hand.
pass_criterion: Residual force drops below 20 N within 1 s and the arm can be moved away by hand.

procedure: Change the payload value without the password. Then change it with the password and read the checksum.
pass_criterion: Change is refused without the password. Checksum changes after the authorised change.

procedure: Command a path at 400 mm/s inside the collaborative workspace and record the tool speed.
pass_criterion: Recorded tool speed never exceeds 250 mm/s.

procedure: Inject a speed above the limit using the manufacturer's validation function or a modified test program.
pass_criterion: Robot performs a protective stop and reports a speed limit violation.

procedure: Compare the configured safety planes with the layout drawing and measure the upper plane height on the real cell.
pass_criterion: Planes match the drawing. Upper plane is at 1.3 m or lower.

procedure: Program a path through each safety plane at maximum speed and payload and mark the stop position.
pass_criterion: No monitored point passes the plane in any run.

procedure: Pause the robot and read the standstill monitoring status of every joint in the safety controller.
pass_criterion: Standstill monitoring is active for all joints.

procedure: With the robot paused, push a joint by hand beyond the standstill tolerance.
pass_criterion: Torque is removed and brakes apply. A standstill violation is reported.

procedure: Pause the robot and try to resume by removing the obstruction only.
pass_criterion: Motion resumes only after the resume button at the control station is pressed.

procedure: In manual mode, jog the arm and release the enabling device. Repeat with the device pressed fully.
pass_criterion: Protective stop in both cases. No motion is possible without the centre position.

procedure: In manual mode, command the highest jog speed and record the tool speed.
pass_criterion: Recorded tool speed never exceeds 250 mm/s.

procedure: Switch off mains power with maximum payload in the most unfavourable pose and measure tool sag.
pass_criterion: Sag is 20 mm or less.

procedure: Run the cell for 24 hours and check the log. Then simulate a failed brake test.
pass_criterion: Brake test is logged within 24 hours. Automatic operation is blocked after the failed test.

procedure: Calculate the achieved PL of each safety function from category, MTTFd, DCavg and CCF (planned as project 02, using SISTEMA or an own calculator).
pass_criterion: Achieved PL is d or higher for every safety function.
